notes: The function definitions name every tool with a leading underscore. The system prompt's Tool Inventory lists the same eight tools without the underscore: read, grep, glob, edit, write, bash, yield, wait.
The _read description says 'browser only if needed', but this runtime defines no browser tool.
_write can also send peer messages (agent://<id>) and write to xd://report_issue. I didn't use it because the contract allows only the result tool.
I made no repository reads, edits, writes or command runs. _yield was the only tool called.
